items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I went down, and was accepted by Tommy Dorsey. I arrived June 19th, 1939. I went to work that day... I learned a great deal from Tommy, I played a lot of brushes

ctx.x: Well, what year was this, Cliff?
1939. This is a few weeks after I was discouraged because Glenn Miller wasn't bringing me back. Well, Tommy had had trouble with Dave Tough who was on one of his famous toots.
